grothak_earthquake.prompt_title: Grothak rears up for a slam
grothak_earthquake.prompt_description: The cavern shudders. A boulder-sized fist rises.

options.label: Brace against the wall
options.flavor: You put your back to stone.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Dust fills your mouth but you stay on your feet.
The wall cracks — a chunk catches you in the chest.

options.label: Roll into his leg
options.flavor: You tuck and dive forward.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You get under the slam; your pick opens a gash on his shin.
The slam catches your shoulder — you lose your footing.

options.label: Leap and swing for his face
options.flavor: You go for the throat.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You land a brutal blow on his jaw — teeth fly.
Grothak catches you out of the air; you hit the floor hard.

pudge_hook.prompt_title: The Butcher winds up the hook
pudge_hook.prompt_description: The chain rattles. His arm cocks back.

options.label: Dodge left
options.flavor: You dive for cover.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The hook whips past you.
The hook clips your shoulder.

options.label: Dodge right into a swing
options.flavor: You trade a graze for a counter.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You take it low, land a free hit on his gut.
The hook lands clean — no counter possible.

options.label: Grab the hook
options.flavor: You lunge for the chain.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You yank The Butcher off balance — massive hit!
The Butcher pulls harder — you take the weight.

ogre_multicast.prompt_description: He chants. Three orbs of lightning spark at the tip.

options.label: Hide behind rubble
options.flavor: You break line of sight.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Two orbs hit rock; one clips your arm.
The orbs curve around the rubble.

options.label: Interrupt the chant
options.flavor: You sprint at him.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You crack his club hand; chant fizzles.
He finishes first — you're caught in the blast.

options.label: Take it and counter
options.flavor: You plant your feet.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Burned but clear-headed, you punish him.
The triple-cast lands — all three.

grothak_crumble_wall.prompt_description: The wall cracks. A ton of rock starts sliding down.

options.label: Shoulder-check him into it
options.flavor: Return his gift.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You ram him into the slide — rocks bury his leg.
You both catch stone. He gets the worst of it.
He doesn't budge. You bounce off and get buried.

options.label: Dive under a ledge
options.flavor: You flatten against the floor.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Rocks pile on the ledge above you. You crawl out clean.
The ledge gives out. You're pinned for the round.

options.label: Sprint straight through the slide
options.flavor: Outrun the landslide.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You clear it; a loose rock thwacks Grothak on the way.
You trip. A cascade of rock rolls over your back.

pudge_rot.prompt_title: The Butcher belches a cloud of rot
pudge_rot.prompt_description: A green miasma rolls off his belly toward you.

options.label: Back off through it
options.flavor: Retreat on foot.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You cough your way out. Mostly clear.
The rot eats through your gloves.

options.label: Push into the cloud
options.flavor: He can't rot himself.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He flinches from his own stench; you land a hit.
Wrong — he loves his stench. You take the brunt.

options.label: Ignite the cloud
options.flavor: Toss a torch.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Whoof. The cloud lights up and blasts The Butcher back.
It wasn't flammable. You were. Somehow.

ogre_fireblast.prompt_title: The Twin-Skulled chants a slow fire blast
ogre_fireblast.prompt_description: Left head counts down. Right head forgot the number.

options.label: Slap the left head
options.flavor: Interrupt the smart one.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Left head loses count. The spell fizzles on him.
Right head finishes the chant anyway.

options.label: Confuse both heads
options.flavor: Shout nonsense at them.

outcome_rolls.narrative: They argue mid-cast; you both eat a weak spark.
They ignore you. The blast lands.

options.label: Stand in front and grin
options.flavor: Bet on the miscast.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Right head casts backwards. Ogre lights himself up.
They both cast correctly for once. Disaster.

crystalia_prism.prompt_description: Three copies of her appear. They all move together.

options.label: Attack the centre copy
options.flavor: You strike geometry itself.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The centre shatters — the real Crystalia flinches.
You picked a prism. Glass shards fly at you.

options.label: Close your eyes and listen
options.flavor: You trust your ears.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You hear her breath and strike blind.
She moves silently; you swing at nothing.

options.label: Swing in a wide arc
options.flavor: You hit everything.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Two prisms and the real her — clean sweep.
Fragments everywhere. You cut her once but cost yourself.

cm_frostbite.prompt_description: Ice crawls up your boots. Your breath fogs.

options.label: Stomp the ice
options.flavor: You break it with force.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You shatter free before it sets.
The ice grabs a foot; you limp.

options.label: Close the distance
options.flavor: You rush her.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You cut her chant short. Worth the freeze.
She finishes — your legs seize up.

options.label: Stand still and wait
options.flavor: Ride it out.

outcome_rolls.narrative: She miscounts. The freeze fizzles.
You freeze solid. Turn wasted.

tusk_snowball.prompt_title: the Warlord packs a snowball the size of a bison
tusk_snowball.prompt_description: He's rolling it faster than should be possible.

options.label: Sidestep the ball
options.flavor: You wait for the last second.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The ball blasts past you into the wall.
You mistimed — the ball clips you HARD.

options.label: Smash the ball
options.flavor: You swing for a split.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Ice explodes; you tag the Warlord through the spray.
Ball holds together. It hits you like a truck.

options.label: Ride the ball
options.flavor: You leap on top.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You surf the ball straight into the Warlord — perfect hit.
You slip off; the ball rolls over you.

crystalia_shatter.prompt_title: Crystalia grows a barrage of shards
crystalia_shatter.prompt_description: A ring of dagger-like crystals levitates, tips pointed at you.

options.label: Dive between the shards
options.flavor: Thread the needle.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You weave through; one grazes your ribs.
One catches you high on the shoulder.

options.label: Shatter a shard mid-flight
options.flavor: Knock one into the others.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Chain reaction — shards redirect into her flank.
You crack one; the rest still find you.
Perfect shot. The whole barrage ricochets home.

options.label: Mirror the barrage back
options.flavor: Pickaxe as shield.

outcome_rolls.narrative: A flawless reflection. She staggers.
The pick can't hold. Shards sheer through it.

cm_freezing_field.prompt_description: Ice bombs detonate randomly in a wide ring around her.

options.label: Stay at the outer edge
options.flavor: Dance the perimeter.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You ride the edge; only the shockwaves clip you.
An outer bomb catches your heel.

options.label: Zigzag toward her
options.flavor: Commit to the kill.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You reach her through the barrage — big crack to the jaw.
Two bombs land close. You go face-first into slush.

options.label: Hug her — bombs miss point-blank
options.flavor: Into her bubble.

outcome_rolls.narrative: No bomb lands inside. She panics and flails.
The bubble shifts. You end up in a crater.

tusk_walrus_punch.prompt_title: the Warlord cocks back a tusked strike
tusk_walrus_punch.prompt_description: His whole body winds up. His fist glows cyan.

options.label: Duck the uppercut
options.flavor: Hit the deck.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You drop under it. His arm whiffs overhead.
His follow-through catches your back.

options.label: Counter-punch his chin
options.flavor: Fist meets fist.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You rock him first. He crumples.
He wins the exchange, brutally.
Clash. You both stagger.

options.label: Let him connect, ride it
options.flavor: Roll with the hit.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You turn with it. Barely a scratch.
He launches you skyward. You land wrong.

magmus_eruption.prompt_title: Magmus Rex plunges his fist into the lava
magmus_eruption.prompt_description: The floor glows orange in a spreading ring.

options.label: Climb the wall
options.flavor: You scramble up.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You perch on a ledge as the eruption blows past.
You slip mid-climb. The heat catches you.

options.label: Sprint toward him
options.flavor: The centre of the ring is the safest spot.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You reach him through the pillars and land a hit.
A geyser catches you dead-on.

options.label: Dive into a cooling pool
options.flavor: You spot a dark puddle.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The water hisses but you come out healed.
It was molten tar. Very much not cooling.

lina_laguna.prompt_title: the Scorchwitch charges a crackling lightning lance
lina_laguna.prompt_description: Lightning arcs between her fingertips. Her hair lifts.

options.label: Hide behind a stalagmite
options.flavor: You put rock between you.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The bolt forks around the stone; some still catches you.
It punches through — you're crisped.

options.label: Charge her as she casts
options.flavor: The channel is long. You close.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You interrupt her mid-chant. Clean hit.
You don't make it. The blade finishes.

options.label: Hold up your pickaxe as a lightning rod
options.flavor: A thin hope.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The blade arcs up the pick and back into HER. Insane.
The pick shatters in your hand. You don't.

doom_mark.prompt_title: The Deathbringer brands you with a black sigil
doom_mark.prompt_description: You feel it burn. He says: 'Silence. The Deathbringer approaches.'

options.label: Attack through it
options.flavor: Ignore the mark.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You land hits. The mark pulses but holds.
Mid-swing, the mark silences you.

options.label: Try to burn it off
options.flavor: You scrape the sigil with your flame.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The mark smolders out. Clean.
You burn yourself badly. The mark remains.

options.label: Offer him something in trade
options.flavor: You toss a JC coin.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The Deathbringer laughs, removes the mark, then hits himself. Weird.
The Deathbringer accepts. The mark stays.

magmus_meteor.prompt_title: Magmus Rex marks you for a meteor
magmus_meteor.prompt_description: A red crosshair paints the ground at your feet.

options.label: Sprint out of the circle
options.flavor: Full sprint sideways.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You clear it. The meteor cratrs empty ground.
Close call — the shockwave scorches your flank.

options.label: Drag him into the circle
options.flavor: Bait his own rock.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Both of you eat it. He takes far worse.
He doesn't budge. You eat the meteor.
He stumbles in. Direct hit. He's stunned.

options.label: Meet it with your pick raised
options.flavor: Block the sky.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You split the meteor. Chunks tag him.
The pick vaporizes. So does much of you.

lina_dragon_slave.prompt_title: the Scorchwitch conjures a rolling flame wave
lina_dragon_slave.prompt_description: A wave of dragon-shaped fire rolls down the corridor.

options.label: Flatten against the floor
options.flavor: Hug the ground.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The fire passes over. You get a bit singed.
It dips low at the wrong moment.

options.label: Leap over the wave
options.flavor: Time the jump.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You clear it clean and clip the Scorchwitch on the landing.
Mistimed. The dragon's mouth catches you mid-air.

options.label: Redirect with a swing
options.flavor: Bat the fire back.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Impossibly, it works. the Scorchwitch gets scorched.
Fire doesn't care about your pickaxe.

doom_scorched_earth.prompt_title: The Deathbringer bathes the floor in infernal flame
doom_scorched_earth.prompt_description: Everywhere you step burns. He alone is untouched.

options.label: Keep moving — never stand still
options.flavor: Hot feet.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You trade sparks with him in motion.
He catches you on a pivot. Whole boot lights up.

options.label: Stand on a rock pillar
options.flavor: Find a dry spot.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You perch. The flame licks but doesn't climb.
The Deathbringer kicks the pillar. You tumble into the fire.

options.label: Roll through and tackle him
options.flavor: Eat floor on the way.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You drag him down. Roll him through his own flame.
You roll into his boot. He was ready for that.

voidwarden_collapse.prompt_title: The Void Warden folds the room
voidwarden_collapse.prompt_description: Gravity tilts. The ceiling is below you now.

options.label: Accept the geometry
options.flavor: You fall up.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You land a kick from a weird angle — connects.
Your aim is ruined. You swing at the floor.

options.label: Close your eyes
options.flavor: You fight by feel.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You find him by breath. He's exposed.
You walk into a wall. It punches back.

options.label: Throw yourself at the warp
options.flavor: Charge the eye of it.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You punch straight through. He fumbles.
The warp eats you and spits you out winded.

spectre_haunt.prompt_description: Shadow versions of her fan out around you.

options.label: Pick a copy at random
options.flavor: Full commit.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Lucky guess. The real The Shade reels.
The copy cuts you as it dissolves.

options.label: Defensive stance — wait
options.flavor: Let them strike first.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The real The Shade's footfall is heavier.
They all hit at once. You can't block them all.

options.label: Spin swing
options.flavor: Hit them all.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You sweep through two shadows and the real one.
You miss the original. They counter from behind.

void_spirit_step.prompt_title: the Astral Echo steps sideways in time
void_spirit_step.prompt_description: He's there. Then he's not. Then he's there.

options.label: Predict the return point
options.flavor: You guess where.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Nailed it. He materializes on your pick.
Wrong side. He appears behind you.

options.label: Stand still and watch
options.flavor: Listen for the phase-in hum.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You trade blows; you both get one.
You were too slow. He got the first swing.

options.label: Chase into the rift
options.flavor: Jump in after him.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You follow him and catch him in the void — pure hit.
The rift spits you somewhere wrong.

voidwarden_silence.prompt_title: The Void Warden drops a silent bubble
voidwarden_silence.prompt_description: Inside the sphere, no sound exists. Your pick makes no impact.

options.label: Fight without sound
options.flavor: Feel the hits.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You land two blind hits. One is very solid.
You swing at echoes and miss.

options.label: Step out of the sphere
options.flavor: Back to noise.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You escape the bubble clean.
The sphere drags with you. You're pinned half-in.

options.label: Scream into the silence
options.flavor: Will sound into being.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Your voice cracks the bubble. He's exposed.
The sphere swallows your scream. You're left gasping.

spectre_dagger.prompt_title: The Shade throws a phantom dagger
spectre_dagger.prompt_description: A trail of shadow ink marks the dagger's flight.

options.label: Follow the trail back at her
options.flavor: Run the line.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You sprint the trail and crash into her.
She vanishes mid-trail. You hit empty ink.

options.label: Catch the dagger
options.flavor: Pluck it from the air.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You grab it and throw it back, clean.
It slices your palm open.
The dagger hangs in air; you steal it mid-flight.

options.label: Let the trail pass over you
options.flavor: Accept the slow.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The ink clings. You move slow but the dagger missed.
The trail loops back. You're glued to the spot.

void_spirit_aether.prompt_title: the Astral Echo folds aether around you
void_spirit_aether.prompt_description: A sphere of compressed dimension pins you in place.

options.label: Push the sphere's walls out
options.flavor: Widen the cage.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You stretch it. You both take bruises.
You overextend. The sphere snaps back hard.

options.label: Collapse the sphere inward
options.flavor: Let it crush.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You drag him in. The collapse hurts you both; him more.
Only you were inside. Compression costs you dearly.

options.label: Stand still and meditate
options.flavor: Refuse the warp.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Your stillness destabilizes it. He flickers.
The sphere tightens. Your ribs disagree.

sporeling_cloud.prompt_title: Sporeling Sovereign releases a spore cloud
sporeling_cloud.prompt_description: The air turns thick and sweet.

options.label: Hold your breath
options.flavor: Don't inhale.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You hold on. Barely.
You gasp. Spores root in your lungs.

options.label: Set it on fire
options.flavor: Torch the air itself.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Clean burn. The whole mass lights up.
You blew yourself up. Not ideal.

options.label: Breathe it in
options.flavor: Become the spore.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You attune to the mycelium — it helps you, somehow.
You're a spore garden now. It hurts.

treant_overgrowth.prompt_title: the Elder Grove grows roots around you

options.label: Cut through the roots
options.flavor: Pickaxe work.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You chop free in a few swings.
Roots keep regrowing. You spend the round.

options.label: Climb the vines
options.flavor: Go up instead of through.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You get above and slash down at his crown.
The vines whip you down. Thorns everywhere.

options.label: Call the roots to yourself
options.flavor: Bluff mycology.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The vines bind the Elder Grove instead. Confusing but fine.
The Elder Grove does not take kindly to bad mimicry.

broodmother_spawn.prompt_title: The Nestmother births a brood of spiderlings
broodmother_spawn.prompt_description: A dozen fist-sized spiders skitter toward your legs.

options.label: Stomp them all
options.flavor: Wide kicks.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Crunch. Crunch. Crunch. You kill most.
Bites everywhere. They were faster than you.

options.label: Let them pass — attack mama
options.flavor: Push through.

outcome_rolls.narrative: They bite you but you reach her. Trade.
Too many bites. You don't reach her.

options.label: Stand perfectly still
options.flavor: They hunt by vibration.

outcome_rolls.narrative: They skitter past. Mama is confused.
One of them noticed. Then all of them.

sporeling_roots.prompt_title: Sporeling Sovereign threads mycelium around your ankles
sporeling_roots.prompt_description: White fungal threads braid up your legs, tightening fast.

options.label: Rip the threads with brute force
options.flavor: Muscle through.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You tear free; skin goes with it.
The threads hook barbs in. They don't let go clean.

options.label: Cut the mycelium at the source
options.flavor: Chop its root.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You sever the main trunk. Sovereign howls.
The trunk regrows. You spend the round hacking.

options.label: Let it grow — become rooted
options.flavor: Dig in.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You anchor and swing from stability. Clean hit.
The roots drink from you. You become garden.

treant_leech_seed.prompt_title: the Elder Grove plants a life seed in you
treant_leech_seed.prompt_description: A hot bead burrows under your skin and starts drinking.

options.label: Dig the seed out
options.flavor: Knifepoint surgery.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You pry it out. It stung, but you're clean.
You cut too deep. The seed hangs on anyway.

options.label: Feed it with a hit to the Grove
options.flavor: Spread the drain.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The seed's tether reverses — he drinks from himself.
Your contact strengthens the bond. Bad trade.

options.label: Ignore it and fight
options.flavor: Not his tempo.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You outdamage the drain this round.
The seed drinks as you swing. You weaken fast.

broodmother_web.prompt_title: The Nestmother spins a web trap
broodmother_web.prompt_description: Sticky silk criss-crosses the cavern at knee height.

options.label: Burn the web
options.flavor: Torch it.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The web goes up. A flaming strand catches her too.
The silk is oiled. You light yourself up.

options.label: Crawl under on your belly
options.flavor: Go low.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You slither out. You spent the round on the ground.
A lower strand catches your neck.

options.label: Swing on a strand
options.flavor: Tarzan the web.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You swing right into The Nestmother. Terrifying for her.
The strand snaps. Silk and fangs everywhere.

chronofrost_still.prompt_description: You can see his breath. You cannot see yours.

options.label: Fight the stillness
options.flavor: You force a step.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You break out and land a sluggish hit.
You stay frozen. He doesn't.

options.label: Sit down and wait
options.flavor: Ride it out.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He hits you but uses no big ability.
He had all the time in the world.

options.label: Turn his time against him
options.flavor: You try to step between ticks.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You find a seam in the stop and stab it wide.
Time punishes arrogance. You seize up.

faceless_void_chrono.prompt_title: the Timeless One summons a time sphere
faceless_void_chrono.prompt_description: A dome of stopped time rises around you both.

options.label: Attack wildly inside the sphere
options.flavor: He's immune. You still have to try.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You clip him in the gap between ticks.
He takes his time with you.

options.label: Run for the edge
options.flavor: Get outside the sphere.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You stumble out. He follows but the chrono breaks.
You don't make it. He makes sure.

options.label: Kneel and close your eyes
options.flavor: Refuse the fight.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He finds that uninteresting and lets the chrono lapse.
He uses the time productively, mostly on you.

weaver_timelapse.prompt_description: He phases away and reappears at full HP a moment ago.

options.label: Attack as he snaps back
options.flavor: Read the line.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You hit him the instant he reforms.
You misread the lapse direction.

options.label: Accept the heal and wait
options.flavor: Let him reset.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He returns but has to rebuild his attack. You buy time.
He reappears already swinging.

options.label: Grab a thread of his time
options.flavor: Rewind with him.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You end up in the past with him — you HEAL and catch him off guard.
You let go too late. The thread slices you open.

chronofrost_rewind.prompt_description: Every scar on him un-stitches and vanishes.

options.label: Strike the seam of his rewind
options.flavor: Find the join.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You hit the seam. His heal rebounds.
You strike empty air. The rewind catches you instead.

options.label: Force your own rewind
options.flavor: Ride the wave.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Your wounds un-happen. You heal on his tick.
You can't catch the thread. You age instead.

options.label: Let him heal, swing anyway
options.flavor: Start fresh.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You don't interrupt; you just keep hitting him.
He finishes the rewind and parries.

faceless_void_backtrack.prompt_title: the Timeless One Backtracks your attack
faceless_void_backtrack.prompt_description: He rewinds a half-second. Your last swing un-happens.

options.label: Swing again harder
options.flavor: Twice the effort.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The second swing lands, past his rewind window.
He backtracks again. You've wasted two rounds.

options.label: Wait out the rewind
options.flavor: Let him run dry.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He backtracks into nothing. You breathe easy.
He uses the free second to gut-punch you.

options.label: Feint and follow through
options.flavor: Bait the rewind.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He backtracks the feint. The real swing lands clean.
He saw the feint coming because of course he did.

weaver_shukuchi.prompt_title: the Skitterwing flickers out of view
weaver_shukuchi.prompt_description: He phases invisible. Tiny mandibles click somewhere in the dark.

options.label: Swing where you heard the click
options.flavor: Ear target.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Blind hit. He shimmers into view, bleeding.
You hit air. The clicks were a trick.

options.label: Set the floor on fire
options.flavor: He has to step somewhere.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He steps into flame; the flicker breaks.
He phased over. You scorched yourself.

options.label: Stand dead still and listen
options.flavor: Make him come to you.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He brushes past; you feel the draft. He's exposed.
He phases through your back. Vicious.

nameless_whisper.prompt_title: The Nameless Depth whispers your name
nameless_whisper.prompt_description: It sounds like your own voice. It knows things you don't.

options.label: Answer it
options.flavor: Speak back.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You name it in return. It flinches.
Your voice wavers. It takes that wavering.

options.label: Refuse the name
options.flavor: You are not that person.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The whisper loses purchase and fades.
It was the right name. The refusal costs you.

options.label: Offer a new name
options.flavor: Give it a false one.

outcome_rolls.narrative: It accepts the lie. Takes that name and leaves.
It never accepted false names. It is upset.

oracle_fortune.prompt_title: the Seer calls down fate's edge on you
oracle_fortune.prompt_description: A coin spins between you. It is both sides at once.

options.label: Call heads
options.flavor: You commit.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You win. The fate bends your way.
You lose. The fate bends hers.

options.label: Call tails
options.flavor: Statistically equivalent.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You win. The fate bends your way.
You lose. The fate bends hers.

options.label: Refuse to call
options.flavor: You palm the coin.

outcome_rolls.narrative: She takes a neutral price. Both of you pay.
the Seer dislikes unresolved fortunes.

terrorblade_sunder.prompt_description: He's at high HP. You are not. He wants to trade.

options.label: Let the sunder land
options.flavor: Accept the swap.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You swap HPs. You're healthier — he is healthier-than-before too, actually.

options.label: Interrupt the sunder
options.flavor: You lunge at him.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You break his concentration.
The soul-trade lands and cuts you both. He does better out of it.

options.label: Reflect the sunder
options.flavor: Hold up your own pick.

outcome_rolls.narrative: It bounces. He gets sundered by himself. He's displeased.
The mirror was a lie. You take it in the chest.

nameless_silence.prompt_title: The Nameless Depth drinks all sound
nameless_silence.prompt_description: Your heartbeat is inaudible. Even your thoughts dim.

options.label: Hum a childhood song
options.flavor: Hold onto something familiar.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The hum holds. You both feel small.
It takes the song too. You forget the tune.

options.label: Shout your own name
options.flavor: Reassert you exist.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The Depth flinches; it cannot unknow you.
It swallowed the name before you finished it.

options.label: Stay silent and listen
options.flavor: Hear what it hears.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You catch its rhythm. Your pick finds the gap.
You lose your voice entirely for a round.

oracle_false_promise.prompt_title: the Seer places a false vow on you
oracle_false_promise.prompt_description: For a moment all damage is suspended. When it ends — everything resolves.

options.label: Attack recklessly during the promise
options.flavor: Nothing can hurt you... yet.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You land huge hits. The promise ends. You pay some cost.
Your damage taken accumulated. Still a decent trade.
She extended the promise's back-end. It all hits you.

options.label: Heal during the promise
options.flavor: Bank the hit points.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You pour potion into your wounds; they hold.
The heal was promised away. You end worse.

options.label: Refuse to act at all
options.flavor: Wait it out.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The promise lapses. You take a small tax.
She extends it. You're locked a round.

terrorblade_metamorphosis.prompt_title: the Sundered Prince enters his demon form
terrorblade_metamorphosis.prompt_description: His wings unfurl. His next three swings will be ranged and devastating.

options.label: Close the distance immediately
options.flavor: Get inside his reach.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Inside his range, his power drops. You trade well.
He swats you before you reach him.

options.label: Hide behind cover
options.flavor: Wait out the duration.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Two bolts miss. One scrapes the rock.
The bolts punch through cover. You curl up.

options.label: Counter with your own pick throw
options.flavor: Range vs range.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Your throw catches him mid-bolt. Big dent.
He out-ranges you effortlessly.

king_decree.prompt_description: A bony hand rises. "Kneel, or be unmade."

options.label: Kneel — perform the gesture
options.flavor: You drop to one knee. The crown approves.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He nods. Etiquette satisfied. You strike a leg cleanly.
He smiles, then kicks you in the ribs. Tradition.

options.label: Strike at the crown
options.flavor: You vault forward, pick raised.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Glancing blow on the crown — he reels.
His scepter cracks across your jaw. The throne speaks.

options.label: Defy verbally
options.flavor: "I owe no king down here."

outcome_rolls.narrative: He laughs, surprised. A truce of sorts.
His ring backhands you. The cut is shallow but deep enough.

king_feast.prompt_description: His mouth is no longer a mouth. It is a question.

options.label: Throw a loose stone
options.flavor: You skip a shard of rubble across the maw.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He snaps at the clatter. You land two clean strikes.
He ignores the feint and lashes back. Trade.

options.label: Strike the open throat
options.flavor: You aim at the vulnerable second.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Pick through cartilage. He chokes on his own scream.
The throat snaps shut on your wrist.

options.label: Hold the outer ring
options.flavor: You keep a measured distance from the hunger.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You let the lunge fall short and keep your footing.
His reach clips you, but your retreat opens his guard.

king_deathbed.prompt_title: The King speaks his last lesson
king_deathbed.prompt_description: His voice frays. He has one truth left to give — or to take.

options.label: Listen — let him finish
options.flavor: You lower your weapon. He nods.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He whispers a weakness in his armor. The crown brightens, then dims.
His final word was a curse. You stagger.

options.label: End it now
options.flavor: No last words. No last anything.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Your strike lands clean. The court grows silent.
He chose this end and prepared for it. Counter-strike.

options.label: Match his stillness
options.flavor: You wait, watching the crown.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He moves first, but slowly. You catch him on the turn.
Both of you blink. Both of you bleed.

hollow_walls_close.prompt_description: The chamber narrows. Stone teeth grow from the ceiling.

options.label: Climb above the stone teeth
options.flavor: You scramble up the wall.

outcome_rolls.narrative: From above you find a soft seam. Two clean strikes.
Your foothold gives. You drop hard.

options.label: Risk a brace against the crush
options.flavor: You wedge your pick into the wall.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The squeeze stalls. Both of you stuck, both of you bleeding.
The walls find your ribs. They keep going.

options.label: Dig sideways through the wall
options.flavor: You commit to a third tunnel.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Sideways breakthrough. You strike from outside the squeeze.
The wall fights back. You take a face full of grit.

hollow_shape_shift.prompt_description: The mineral body folds inward, then reassembles in a new outline.

options.label: Predict the new edge
options.flavor: You commit to where it will be.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You called it. Pick lands where the wall finishes forming.
Wrong guess. The new edge meets your face.

options.label: Wait it out
options.flavor: You hold ground and watch.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You let the new shape settle before choosing your ground.
A last edge catches you, but you chip it as you give ground.

options.label: Charge through the shifting form
options.flavor: You commit before it solidifies.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You catch it half-formed. The body shudders apart.
It hardens around you. You're inside the wall, briefly.

hollow_many_voices.prompt_title: A chorus rises from every wall
hollow_many_voices.prompt_description: The mine speaks at once. Names. Insults. Promises.

options.label: Listen for the loudest voice
options.flavor: You hunt the source.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You find the speaker. Pick to vein.
The voices drown your thoughts. You hesitate.

options.label: Ignore the chorus and swing
options.flavor: You attack the air at random.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You hit something. Hard to say what.
The voices were a feint. The real strike came from behind.

options.label: Sing back
options.flavor: You match their pitch with a curse of your own.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The chorus quiets around your steady note. You chip the wall.
Your voice cracks, but the chorus loses its rhythm too.

digger_pickaxe_duel.prompt_title: The First Digger raises his pickaxe
digger_pickaxe_duel.prompt_description: Two diggers, one tunnel. Only one pick will leave whole.

options.label: Parry his swing
options.flavor: You meet pick with pick.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Sparks. Both of you push back. Even trade.
His pick has more weight than you expected.

options.label: Sidestep and drive in
options.flavor: You commit to advance.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You slip past — pick to the chest.
He pivots faster than you. Your ribs find his haft.

options.label: Lock haft to haft, push him into the wall
options.flavor: A wrestler's move underground.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You turn the lock and drive him hard into the wall.
He has done this for centuries. The wall catches you instead.

digger_phasing.prompt_title: He flickers between solid and not
digger_phasing.prompt_description: Half a step out of phase, the Digger blinks through your strikes.

options.label: Anticipate his solid moment
options.flavor: You hold and time the swing.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Caught mid-phase. Pick passes through skin first, then air.
Wrong moment. You swing through nothing while he was already behind.

options.label: Trap him with terrain
options.flavor: You back into a corner he must turn through.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He has to commit to a direction. You have it covered.
He passes through stone. He was never going to commit.

options.label: Phase yourself — match his rhythm
options.flavor: You step out of phase too. Maybe.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You both drop into the half-place. You hit harder there.
You weren't ready. He drags you back the wrong way.

digger_tunnel_collapse.prompt_description: "I am the tunnel," he says. The walls listen.

options.label: Dig out — straight up
options.flavor: You commit to the surface.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You break a vent and stagger. The collapse passes around you.
The vent caves. Stone wedges your shoulder.

options.label: Flatten — let it pass over
options.flavor: You drop and pray.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Most of it passes. The last block clips your hip.
You weren't flat enough. Something heavy finds you.

options.label: Push deeper — into him
options.flavor: If he is the tunnel, you can attack the tunnel.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You strike the floor — and he flinches.
The floor swallows you both. Painful for both of you.

aegis_reclaim.prompt_title: The aegis lights with a borrowed heartbeat
aegis_reclaim.prompt_description: The Warden lifts the shield. The next mistake wants to happen twice.

options.label: Crack the shield edge
options.flavor: You swing for the weakest glow.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The shield cracks; his return flickers.
The shield rolls the blow aside and numbs your arm.

options.label: Wait out the glow
options.flavor: You hold distance and count breaths.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The glow fades before it can spend itself.
You waited too long; he retakes the tempo.

options.label: Bait the return
options.flavor: You offer a false opening.

outcome_rolls.narrative: He commits to the return; you punish the second step.
He reads the bait and shieldsmashes through it.

heartspire_intent.prompt_description: A red line, a shielded line, and a lie pulse across the stone.

options.label: Block the red line
options.flavor: You trust the obvious threat.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The line strikes your guard and breaks there.
The obvious threat was only half of it.

options.label: Strike the shielded line
options.flavor: You attack the defense.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The shielded line opens. The heart is briefly exposed.
You hit the guard and the guard hits back.

options.label: Ignore the lie
options.flavor: You choose the line that is not pulsing.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The hidden line was the real path. Your pick finds it.
The lie was bait. The spire was counting on you.

emberwright_overclock.prompt_description: Gears glow white. The forge starts eating its own light.

options.label: Vent the engine
options.flavor: You break open a pressure valve.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Steam and sparks vent upward. The engine stutters.
The valve vents through you first.

options.label: Kick slag into the gears
options.flavor: Jam the machine with its own waste.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The gears choke on slag. The forge is exposed.
The gears spit the slag back, still molten.

options.label: Ride the heat wave
options.flavor: Use the blast to close distance.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You surf the blast straight into a brutal strike.
The wave lifts you, then the ceiling returns you.

xalatath_void_pull.prompt_description: The dark below your feet has a direction. Toward her.

options.label: Anchor to the wall
options.flavor: You drive your pick into stone.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You hold. Something brushes past your ankle.
The pick slips. You hear yourself stop existing for a moment.

options.label: Let the pull take you
options.flavor: Use the momentum. Strike on the way in.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You ride the seam. Your pick finds her ribs.
She closes the seam around you. Something tears.

options.label: Speak her name back
options.flavor: If she heard you, she might hesitate.

outcome_rolls.narrative: She pauses. The seam slackens. Her shape thins.
You said it wrong. The name takes more than you offered.

xalatath_whisper_madness.prompt_title: A whisper, not in your ear
xalatath_whisper_madness.prompt_description: It's already in your head. It's been there a while.

options.label: Listen carefully
options.flavor: Hear it out.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You catch a syllable that wasn't meant for you. She flinches.
The whisper folds. You can't recall a word now.

options.label: Cover your ears and hum
options.flavor: Drown her out with noise.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The hum holds. The whisper retreats — for now.
She whispered louder. The hum cracks. So does your nerve.

options.label: Repeat the whisper aloud
options.flavor: Give it back to her.

outcome_rolls.narrative: She didn't expect that. The whisper recoils into her.
You said it. You shouldn't have. Something rearranges in your chest.

lilith_blood_nova.prompt_description: It hangs around her like a held breath.

options.label: Take cover behind a column
options.flavor: Let the wave pass.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The column splatters. Most of you stays dry.
It found a seam in the stone. It found yours too.

options.label: Dive through the center
options.flavor: Take the wave at her.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You break through. She's too close to escape your pick.
The wave is denser than it looks. You stagger out of it red.

options.label: Stand still and let it find you
options.flavor: Bleed back what's hers.

outcome_rolls.narrative: She underestimated you. The blood reads your shape and reveals hers.
The blood remembers you. Cycle bleed. You miss a beat.

lilith_wing_descent.prompt_title: She rises on two black wings
lilith_wing_descent.prompt_description: Higher than the ceiling should allow. She is going to come down.

options.label: Roll under the descent
options.flavor: Time the dodge.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You roll. The crater misses. You hit her ankle going past.
Your timing was a half-beat off. The wing-edge clips you.

options.label: Brace for the impact
options.flavor: Plant and weather it.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The shockwave passes through you. You stay upright.
She landed harder than the floor allowed. So did you.

options.label: Throw your pick at her descent
options.flavor: Interrupt mid-air.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The pick threads between her wings. She drops awkwardly.
She caught it. Now you are unarmed, briefly. She is not.

underlord_pit_pull.prompt_description: A shaft drops into nothing. He's standing at the edge, waiting.

options.label: Catch the lip and haul up
options.flavor: Don't fall. Don't fall.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You catch the rim. Knuckles burn. You climb.
The rim gives. You eat stone on the way back up.

options.label: Drop and strike on the way down
options.flavor: If you're going down, take a piece of him.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You drop into him pick-first. He grunts. He didn't expect that.
He stepped aside. You hit the bottom alone. The bottom is rude.

options.label: Anchor your pick crosswise
options.flavor: Wedge it across the shaft. Stop the fall.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The pick wedges. You hang there. He has to come to you.
The pick shears. You're below him now. He looks down at you.

underlord_firestorm.prompt_description: The ceiling forgets it's stone for a moment.

options.label: Shelter under an outcrop
options.flavor: Wait it out. Take the cooldown.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The rock holds. Heat washes past. You stay dry.
An ember finds the gap. Smolders into your sleeve.

options.label: Sprint through the storm at him
options.flavor: Close the distance under fire.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You come out the other side smoking and swinging. He didn't move in time.
The storm got most of you. The pick got air.

options.label: Use the smoke to flank low
options.flavor: Get under him.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You come up inside his guard. He takes a clean hit.
He saw the smoke move. The pit lord knows smoke.

blightcoil_wards.prompt_title: The Blightcoil spits a ring of plague-wards
blightcoil_wards.prompt_description: Three twitching pods hiss open around you, breathing spores.

options.label: Smash the nearest ward
options.flavor: Crush it before it ripens.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You stomp one flat; the others keep hissing.
Spores burst up your arm as it pops.

options.label: Push through to the coil
options.flavor: Ignore the pods, reach the source.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You wade through the haze and land a hit on the coil.
The wards drain you on the way in.

options.label: Torch the whole ring
options.flavor: Burn the garden down.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The pods catch and chain-burst into the Blightcoil.
Spore-gas is flammable. So, briefly, were you.

blightcoil_nova.prompt_title: The Blightcoil swells with a venom nova
blightcoil_nova.prompt_description: It draws a long breath. The chamber goes green at the edges.

options.label: Hold your breath and back off
options.flavor: Retreat to clean air.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You reach clean air; a little gets in anyway.
You inhale at exactly the wrong moment.

options.label: Charge before it releases
options.flavor: Cut the breath short.

outcome_rolls.narrative: A pick to the throat cuts the nova off at the source.
It exhales in your face. The garden takes root.

options.label: Lance a pod to vent the gas
options.flavor: Give the nova somewhere else to go.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The nova vents sideways through the pod and exposes the coil.
Wrong pod. The gas funnels straight to you.

rimebound_harvest.prompt_title: The Rimebound King raises the runeblade to reap
rimebound_harvest.prompt_description: Frost crawls up the blade. It is hungry for something warm.

options.label: Keep your distance
options.flavor: Stay out of the arc.

outcome_rolls.narrative: The reap falls short; only the cold reaches your fingers.
The edge of the arc catches you; the chill sinks in.

options.label: Step inside the swing
options.flavor: Too close for the blade.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Inside the arc, you hammer the breastplate twice.
He shortens his grip. The blade still finds you.

options.label: Catch the blade on your pick
options.flavor: Bind it and crack his guard.

outcome_rolls.narrative: Sparks fly; you wrench the runeblade wide and crack his guard.
The blade drinks through the pick. He stands a little taller.

rimebound_raise.prompt_title: The Rimebound King raises a frozen thrall
rimebound_raise.prompt_description: A corpse of ice claws its way up from the floor between you.

options.label: Shatter the thrall first
options.flavor: Put it down before it stands.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You smash it to slush before it finds its feet.
It grabs you as it breaks; cold hands, slow to let go.

options.label: Ignore it, press the King
options.flavor: The crown is the real target.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You leave the thrall behind and bury your pick in the King.
The thrall hamstrings you from behind.

options.label: Turn the thrall against him
options.flavor: Shove it into the throne.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You drive the thrall into the King; both stagger, his guard opens.
The thrall obeys only the crown. It pins you for the round.

spineback_regrowth.prompt_title: The Spineback's black spines harden over
spineback_regrowth.prompt_description: The wounds you opened crust with new growth. It is healing in front of you.

options.label: Break the fresh white spines
options.flavor: Hit the soft new growth.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You snap the soft growth; it can't harden there. It flinches.
Wrong spine — the hardened plates turn your blow.

options.label: Hammer the black plates
options.flavor: Chip the hardened armor.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You chip a black plate; slow going, but it holds still for it.
The plates are stone now. Your pick skips into a spine.

options.label: Strike before it finishes
options.flavor: Catch it mid-regrowth.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You catch it mid-knit; the new growth tears away with the old.
It finished first. The fresh spines are already sharp.

spineback_divebomb.prompt_title: The Spineback launches off the wall
spineback_divebomb.prompt_description: It hits the ceiling and folds, spines-first, into a dive straight down at you.

options.label: Dive aside at the last instant
options.flavor: Wait for the commit.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You throw yourself clear; the impact craters where you stood.
A trailing spine rakes your back as it lands.

options.label: Meet it with a raised pick
options.flavor: Set the pick like a spear.

outcome_rolls.narrative: It impales itself on the drop. The sound is tremendous.
It is far heavier than you. You're driven into the floor.

options.label: Roll under to the soft belly
options.flavor: Get beneath the spines.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You slide under the spines and open its underside.
The belly is armored too. The spines are not kind.

grothak_bedrock_bellow.prompt_description: The stone answers him, shaking loose in widening rings.

options.label: Drop below the tremor
options.flavor: You flatten against the floor.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You flatten against the floor. You hold steady.
You flatten against the floor. The timing costs you.

options.label: Strike his ribs
options.flavor: You step inside his breath.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You step inside his breath. The counter opens a weakness.
You step inside his breath. The counter comes a beat late.

options.label: Bellow back
options.flavor: You answer stone with spite.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You answer stone with spite. The gamble lands cleanly.
You answer stone with spite. The gamble turns against you.

crystalia_mirror_maze.prompt_title: Crystalia folds the chamber into mirrors
crystalia_mirror_maze.prompt_description: Every reflection raises a pick half a heartbeat before you do.

options.label: Watch the floor
options.flavor: You follow the one shadow that stays true.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You follow the one shadow that stays true. You hold steady.
You follow the one shadow that stays true. The timing costs you.

options.label: Crack the dull mirror
options.flavor: You find the facet without light.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You find the facet without light. The counter opens a weakness.
You find the facet without light. The counter comes a beat late.

options.label: Charge your reflection
options.flavor: You sprint at your own raised pick.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You sprint at your own raised pick. The gamble lands cleanly.
You sprint at your own raised pick. The gamble turns against you.

magmus_lava_tide.prompt_description: A molten tide climbs the cavern toward your boots.

options.label: Climb the basalt shelf
options.flavor: You scramble above the orange wash.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You scramble above the orange wash. You hold steady.
You scramble above the orange wash. The timing costs you.

options.label: Cut a cooling trench
options.flavor: You split the black crust ahead of it.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You split the black crust ahead of it. The counter opens a weakness.
You split the black crust ahead of it. The counter comes a beat late.

options.label: Vault through the crest
options.flavor: You leap where the lava curls highest.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You leap where the lava curls highest. The gamble lands cleanly.
You leap where the lava curls highest. The gamble turns against you.

voidwarden_gravity_well.prompt_title: The Void Warden removes the floor's permission
voidwarden_gravity_well.prompt_description: Dust, stone, and your own limbs begin falling sideways.

options.label: Anchor to a seam
options.flavor: You hook your pick into stubborn stone.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You hook your pick into stubborn stone. You hold steady.
You hook your pick into stubborn stone. The timing costs you.

options.label: Cut the dark center
options.flavor: You drag the blade across the well's edge.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You drag the blade across the well's edge. The counter opens a weakness.
You drag the blade across the well's edge. The counter comes a beat late.

options.label: Let the pull sling you
options.flavor: You surrender to the impossible fall.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You surrender to the impossible fall. The gamble lands cleanly.
You surrender to the impossible fall. The gamble turns against you.

sporeling_bloom.prompt_title: The Sovereign blooms all at once
sporeling_bloom.prompt_description: A crown of pale caps opens and sheds hungry motes.

options.label: Cover your mouth
options.flavor: You wrap your sleeve tight.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You wrap your sleeve tight. You hold steady.
You wrap your sleeve tight. The timing costs you.

options.label: Cull the lowest caps
options.flavor: You sweep the fresh blooms away.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You sweep the fresh blooms away. The counter opens a weakness.
You sweep the fresh blooms away. The counter comes a beat late.

options.label: Breathe it in and rush
options.flavor: You charge through the sweet fog.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You charge through the sweet fog. The gamble lands cleanly.
You charge through the sweet fog. The gamble turns against you.

chronofrost_time_shard.prompt_title: Chronofrost breaks off a second of time
chronofrost_time_shard.prompt_description: The blue shard shows your next wound already frozen inside it.

options.label: Wait out the vision
options.flavor: You refuse the moment it offers.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You refuse the moment it offers. You hold steady.
You refuse the moment it offers. The timing costs you.

options.label: Shatter the shard
options.flavor: You strike the frozen second sideways.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You strike the frozen second sideways. The counter opens a weakness.
You strike the frozen second sideways. The counter comes a beat late.

options.label: Step into your future
options.flavor: You meet the wound before it exists.

outcome_rolls.narrative: You meet the wound before it exists. The gamble lands cleanly.
You meet the wound before it exists. The gamble turns against you.
